description: Three governance gaps where the SCP governance model is not fully applied: (1) broadcast projection endpoints ignore context admission policy — gated contexts serve content publicly (§18.11, §5.14.4), (2) metadata visibility exposes all operational fields to anyone with context_id — no governance-configurable per-field visibility (§5.7), (3) no governance-level subscriber ban in broadcast contexts — blocking is per-author only, no cross-author revocation (§5.14.8, §5.9). Fix: ProjectionPolicy with per-author granularity, MetadataVisibilityPolicy with per-field PreJoin/MemberOnly, MemberBan capability gating RevokeReadAccess governance action.

stories.title: Add MemberBan capability, MetadataVisibilityPolicy, ProjectionPolicy, and FieldVisibility types
stories.description: Add foundation types for the three governance gaps. MemberBan capability variant gates RevokeReadAccess governance action per §5.3. MetadataVisibilityPolicy controls per-field metadata visibility per §5.7. ProjectionPolicy controls per-author projection access rules per §18.11. FieldVisibility is the shared enum for pre-join vs member-only visibility. All types added to ContextParams.

stories.title: Implement metadata visibility filtering
stories.description: Add methods to ContextParams that filter metadata based on MetadataVisibilityPolicy. Pre-join callers get structural fields plus operational fields where visibility is PreJoin; members get everything. Structural fields are always visible regardless of policy: template_id, ceiling, ceiling_policy, roles, governance, mode, ttl, promotion_policy, memory_scope, metadata_visibility itself.

stories.title: Implement governance-level subscriber ban in BroadcastContext
stories.description: Add governance-directed subscriber ban to BroadcastContext. Unlike per-author blocking (which is unilateral), governance bans remove the subscriber from the registry AND add them to ALL authors' block lists simultaneously. All authors MUST rotate keys after a governance ban (mandatory KeyEpochAdvance). This mirrors RevokeReadAccess semantics in encrypted contexts (MLS group removal), adapted for broadcast's per-author key model. Does NOT check ceiling — that's the ContextManager's responsibility (SCP-GG-006).

governance_ban_subscriber returns a GovernanceBanResult containing: banned DID, list of author DIDs that rotated, new epochs per author
governance_ban_subscriber returns MemberNotFound if subscriber not in registry
BroadcastContext::governance_unban_subscriber(did) removes the DID from every author's block list
governance_unban_subscriber does NOT re-register the subscriber (they must re-register manually)
governance_unban_subscriber does NOT rotate keys (unban is access restoration, not revocation)

stories.title: Add UCAN validation to projection endpoints for gated contexts
stories.description: Enforce access control on projection endpoints based on admission mode and projection policy. For gated contexts, extract UCAN from Authorization: Bearer <token> header and validate via the same validate_messages_read_ucan() pipeline used in handle_key_request(). For open contexts, serve without auth (current behavior). Per-author overrides in ProjectionPolicy can narrow or specify rules per author DID. Gated projection endpoints use Cache-Control: private (CDN must not cache authenticated content). Reuse validate_messages_read_ucan() from broadcast.rs.
